name: Boon Of Combat Prowess
description: Prerequisite: Level 19+ You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Peerless Aim
features.description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.
